usage.summary:
Implemented the shared TLC budget, limits, cancellation/timeouts, memory diagnostics, flag, and docs. All nine #497 acceptance tests pass.

Full checks still fail seven Python tests because their protected [Docker fixture](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-plumbing-build-3364589230/internal/verify/python_deps_accept_test.go:1227) rejects the required `--memory-swap` flag. Fixing that fixture requires a plan amendment.

I chose a five-second discovery cap and retained slots across retries. The merger must record the resource-policy decision and complete its SPEC citation.
